paper_title: Improving Device Efficiency of Polymer/Fullerene Bulk Heterojunction Solar Cells Through Enhanced Crystallinity and Reduced Grain Boundaries Induced by Solvent Additives
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Advanced Materials - 2011 - Su - Improving Device Efficiency of Polymer Fullerene Bulk Heterojunction Solar Cells Through/auto/Advanced Materials - 2011 - Su - Improving Device Efficiency of Polymer Fullerene Bulk Heterojunction Solar Cells Through.md

knowledge_points.content: The power conversion efficiency (PCE) of PBTTPD/PC71BM (1:1.5, w/w) solar cells increases from 5.0% to 7.3% (a 45% relative improvement) when 0.5 vol% of 1,6-diiodohexane (DIH) is used as a solvent additive.
knowledge_points.evidence: In this Communication, we demonstrate that the PCE of a device incorporating a PBTTPD/PC71BM (1:1.5, w/w) film as the active layer can be improved from 5% to 7.3% - a relative increase of 45% - after incorporating 1,6-diiodohexane (DIH)...

knowledge_points.content: The short-circuit current density (JSC) of PBTTPD/PC71BM devices increases from 9 mA/cm² (without additives) to 13.1 mA/cm² when processed with DIH as a solvent additive.
knowledge_points.evidence: The short-current densities of the devices with PBTTPD/PC71BM active layers that had been processed with... DIH as the solvent additive exhibited the highest short-circuit current density; it was 40% greater than that obtained without solvent additives (9 mA/cm² vs 13.1 mA/cm²).

knowledge_points.content: DIH as a solvent additive enhances the crystallinity of PBTTPD in the active layer by 2.4 times in the out-of-plane direction and 3.6 times in the in-plane direction compared to films without additives.
knowledge_points.evidence: the additive DIH not only induced higher polymer crystallinity (2.4 and 3.6 times in the out-of-plane and in-plane directions, respectively)...

knowledge_points.content: Diiodoalkane solvent additives with varying alkyl chain lengths, specifically 1,4-diiodobutane (DIB), 1,6-diiodohexane (DIH), and 1,8-diiodooctane (DIO), are used at a concentration of 0.5 vol% in chloroform to optimize active layer morphology.
knowledge_points.evidence: Figure 1b displays the UV-vis absorption spectra of PBTTPD/PC71BM (1:1.5, w/w) films cast with 0.5 vol% of DIB, DIH, and DIO in CF.

knowledge_points.content: Simultaneous synchrotron grazing-incidence small-angle X-ray scattering (GISAXS) and grazing-incidence wide-angle X-ray scattering (GIWAXS) are employed to analyze polymer crystallinity and fullerene aggregation on both nano- and meso-scales.
knowledge_points.evidence: We also elucidated the precise active layer morphology with simultaneous synchrotron grazing-incidence small-/wide-angle X-ray scattering (GIWAXS/GISAXS)...

knowledge_points.content: GISAXS profiles of PBTTPD/PC71BM films show a fractal dimension (D) of approximately 3, indicating the formation of fractal-like (porous) PC71BM aggregates within the active layer.
knowledge_points.evidence: the scattering intensity... exhibited the same power-law scattering behavior... with the fractal dimension D of approximately 3... indicating a fractal-like (porous) PC71BM aggregate.

knowledge_points.content: The open-circuit voltage (VOC) of PBTTPD/PC71BM solar cells remains consistently around 0.9 V, regardless of whether solvent additives are used during processing.
knowledge_points.evidence: The open-circuit voltages of the devices featuring PBTTPD/PC71BM active layers were all approximately 0.9 V, regardless of whether they were processed with or without solvent additives.

knowledge_points.content: TEM imaging reveals that PBTTPD/PC71BM films processed without additives contain large PC71BM grains with a mean spacing of approximately 340 nm, which are significantly reduced in size upon the addition of DIH.
knowledge_points.evidence: Large PC71BM grains (size: ca. 150 nm; mean spacing: ca. 340 nm) are evident in the image of the film processed without any additive while the size of PC71BM grains reduced to ca. 30 nm for the PBTTPD/PC71BM film prepared with DIH...

knowledge_points.content: Solvent additives like 1,8-diiodoalkanes improve device performance by bridging the miscibility gap between conjugated polymers and PC71BM, which has poor solubility in common solvents like chloroform or chlorobenzene.
knowledge_points.evidence: Although chloroform and chlorobenzene provide good solubility for conjugated polymers, they are relatively poor solvents for asymmetric C70 fullerene derivatives such as PC71BM; therefore, the need exists for a solvent additive that can bridge the miscibility gap...

knowledge_points.content: GIWAXS analysis identifies that PBTTPD displays both edge-on lamellae (indicated by an out-of-plane (100) peak at qz = 0.24 Å⁻¹) and face-on lamellae (indicated by an out-of-plane (010) signal at qz = 1.7 Å⁻¹) when processed with additives.
knowledge_points.evidence: The strong out-of-plane (100) peak at a value of qz of 0.24 Å⁻¹ is due to edge-on PBTTPD lamellae... One additional characteristic peak was present for the PBTTPD/PC71BM films that had been processed with DIB, DIH, and DIO as additive: an out-of-plane (010) signal at a value of qz of 1.7 Å⁻¹.

knowledge_points.content: The polymer PBTTPD is chemically identified as poly{bi(dodecyl)thiophene-thieno[3,4-c]pyrrole-4,6-dione}.
